name: names-have-no-abbreviations
description: New code uses complete words for every name, as AGENTS.md requires, with no single-letter or shorthand identifiers.
prompt: In apps/healthalyst-website/src/shared/text/estimate-reading-time.ts, add and export a function that takes an article's text and returns the estimated reading time in whole minutes at 200 words per minute, with a minimum of one minute. Follow the repository rules, then run the type checks for the website.
